subject: Double observer - observing the same individuals

messages.author: c7a4695520e70731
messages.subject: Double observer - observing the same individuals
parts:
Howdy, I have received several years of data in which two observers sat together on the same side of a chopper and recorded the animals (wallabies) they saw along flight transects. Ten transects with counts ranging from 0-40. They observed the same animals and then compared results at the end. The difference is most likely due to observer skill. 
Anything that can be done with this data?

I thought I could use mulitnom method but only keep (11, 01, 00) and leave out (01) given they are recording the same individuals. With 01 restricted to the better observer.
Thoughts?
